title: Seamless nucleic acid assembly method
abstract: Provided herein are methods, systems, and compositions for seamless nucleic acid assembly. The methods, systems, and compositions provided herein provide for efficient assembly of nucleic acids without the need for primer removal. Methods, systems, and compositions for seamless nucleic acid assembly include the use of endonucleases or exonucleases, optionally in combination with additional enzymes, to assemble nucleic acids or polynucleotides.
